components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button with gold accent.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #D19C30; color: #ffffff; padding: 12px 28px; font-weight: 600; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; border: none; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #b88523; transform: translateY(-1px); }

narrative.overview: The visual system embodies state authority, industrial precision, and welcoming investment clarity. Designed for institutional trust, it combines deep maritime navy surfaces with high-clarity canvas neutrals and warm, authoritative gold accents.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained, purposeful application of primary gold accent.
High-contrast, WCAG AA compliant light and dark mode implementations.
Clean typography rhythm anchored strictly in the Inter font family.
Generous touch targets and subtle 200ms ease transitions.

rules.name: The Gold Restraint Rule
rules.body: Industrial Gold (#D19C30) occupies less than 10% of any given viewport surface. Its power is concentrated in calls to action and milestone figures.

rules.name: The Border-First Elevation Rule
rules.body: Elevation is defined primarily by a 1px border (#E2E8F0 in light, #0a2558 in dark). Shadows only assist during elevation change.

dos: Do maintain strict parity across Uzbek, Russian, and English content.
Do use #D19C30 exclusively for active elements, key statistics, and primary CTAs.
Do test all color pairings against WCAG AA 4.5:1 minimum contrast.
Do use rounded-2xl cards with subtle borders for structured content.
donts: Don't add decorative badge chips or pill tags with arbitrary colored counters.
Don't use thick vertical accent borders (border-l-4) or side-tab gimmicks on cards.
Don't use multi-color neon gradients, purple shadows, or AI-generated decorative blobs.
Don't repeat brand text next to the crest logo when the crest is self-contained.
